title: Radial Tears

positions.as_written: Assess extrusion, because a radial tear releases the hoop and the meniscus then moves out of the joint.
Repair is harder because the fibres being approximated run across the repair rather than along it.
Repair of a radial tear is mechanically unfavourable and is still often the better option in a young knee, which is a judgement the imaging informs and does not make.
